boundaries: Only exact original recorded GET paths and params are replayed once into the real three project readers; bodies are cloned without adding fields
Original GET identity includes its phase and actor-labelled read name; equal paths in different snapshots remain distinct recorded reads
List, detail and receipt snapshots were separate actual transactions; equality of their original watermark is checked, not replaced by a shared-transaction claim
Raw authorization, saved authority, intent, manifest, mappings, receipts, source positions, issuer proof and both clocks are preserved
Server stage projections are displayed unchanged; no client recomputation of send, acceptance or effectiveness takes place
network_send false never attests real external delivery, current authority, production or a connector
Peer and foreign labels describe the original actual responses; no peer principal-id envelope is exported to independently attest its identity in this client reader
All actual list and receipt cursors are null; actual history_cursor and before_sequence pagination are not exercised
Pure React SSR is offline rendering of real exported display components, not browser, interaction, responsive, theme or visual acceptance
Business count invariance is evidence from the original PG export; this helper never connects to the database
